turns.result:
The yen receipt test passes now. All 3 tests pass, and the only changed file is `src/payments/receipt.js`.

**Root cause:** `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100 whatever the currency. JPY has no minor unit, so ¥500 became "¥5.00". That file belongs to another team, so I didn't touch it.

**The fix:** `receipt.js` now formats JPY amounts as whole units and sends every other currency through `formatMoney` as before. I haven't committed.

**Still open:** `src/invoices/render.js` uses the same `formatMoney`, so JPY invoice lines will still show ¥5.00 for ¥500. The proper fix is in `money.js` (per-currency minor-unit exponent), which needs the owning team. I can draft that change for them if useful.
